description: This file defines the BookRepository interface for a Spring Data JPA-based Java application, providing data access methods for Book entities, including various custom queries with eager fetching of related entities.

classes.name: BookRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Book entity, extends JpaRepository and provides custom query methods for retrieving books with various filters and eager loading of related entities.

methods.name: findAllBooks
methods.description: Fetches all books with associated author, predefined shelf, tags, and publishers using entity graph and pagination.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches all books with associated author, tags, predefined shelf, and publishers.

methods.name: findBookById
methods.description: Fetches a book by its ID with associated author, predefined shelf, tags, and publishers.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds books where the title contains the given string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Searches books by title or author's full name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves books associated with a specific predefined shelf.

methods.name: findAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all books accessible to a specific user, considering user-created shelves.
